correctness.rationale: Generic cube section vertices are exactly the edge boundary of a Boolean halfspace. Self-contained inductive Boolean isoperimetry sandwiches boundary by set cardinality and n times it. The Gaussian direction law under invariant affine-plane conditioning is tilted by directional width; this tilt becomes asymptotically trivial in total variation. A quenched tilted-Rademacher Chernoff upper/lower bound gives I(mu U), yielding the exact limiting CDF. Independent quadrature verifies the endpoint constants; their proof comes from explicit log-cosh asymptotics. The original published mean identity is not asserted as new.

originality.rationale: Target claim is a nonconstant asymptotic law for affine invariant-plane sections, with endpoint rates and a mean/typical divergence. Swan 2016 proves the exact mean; Lonke 1998 derives central section expectations. The De Loera-Lopez-Campos-Torres source concerns realizable vertex-count sequences and extremal values, not probability laws. Published central-hyperplane results do not imply noncentral offset averaging, whose distribution changes the exponential rate. The inaccessible 1991 and 2008 cube probability sources preserve historical uncertainty.
